papers.title: Making Time Editable in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Konstantin Kuklev, Viacheslav Vasilev, Alexander Kunitsyn, Andrei Ivaniuta, Denis Dimitrov
papers.affiliations: Kandinsky Lab
papers.intro: 提出一种基于显式时间分解（全局FPS控制+局部位潜在时间嵌入）的轻量级时间控制模块，扩展预训练DiT，使时间动态成为可直接编辑的变量，无需重新设计骨干网络。

papers.title: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
papers.authors: Nanshan Jia, Zhenyu Zhao, Sui Huang, Jingshen Wang, Zeyu Zheng
papers.affiliations: Nanshan Jia - University of California, Berkeley / Roblox Corporation（双标注优先以第一标注列UC Berkeley）；Zhenyu Zhao - Roblox Corporation；Sui Huang - Roblox Corporation；Jingshen Wang - University of California, Berkeley；Zeyu Zheng - University of California, Berkeley
papers.intro: 本文构建了一个包含2,619个合成3D mesh及其人工评分的数据集和基准（DB-3DME），系统评估了多个先进VLM，发现视觉编码是性能瓶颈，并通过对Qwen-2.5-VL-7B微调视觉编码器（冻结语言模型）实现了显著超越现有VLM的自动3D mesh评估能力。

papers.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
papers.authors: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Abilio de Carvalho Junior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva
papers.affiliations: University of Brasília
papers.intro: iSAGE通过让专家直接点击模型稳定错误（自信错误）的像素，使用错误加权Dice损失训练，在无需任何辅助扩展机制（伪标签、CRF等）的情况下，仅用0.011%的标注像素就在ISPRS Vaihingen数据集上匹配了全监督基线性能（76.78% mIoU vs 76.65%），成为31种调查方法中唯…

papers.title: Maximum Matching Accuracy: An Instance Segmentation Evaluation Metric Utilizing Globally Optimal Matching
papers.authors: Kaden Stillwagon, Alexandra D. VandeLoo, Craig R. Forest
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出Maximum Matching Accuracy（MMA），一种基于全局最优二分图匹配和像素级全局归一化的无阈值连续实例分割评价指标，克服了现有指标的不连续、低敏感度和匹配非最优问题。

papers.title: A Controlled Audit of Pretraining Contamination in Public Medical Vision-Language Benchmarks
papers.authors: Bruce Changlong Xu, Lan Wu, Alexander Ryu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; University of California, Berkeley; Mayo Clinic
papers.intro: 通过对四个开源医学VLMs在三个医学VQA基准上的四探测器审计，发现SLAKE-En存在图像源重叠信号且Qwen2.5-VL在文本侧存在交换性信号，同时证明基于群体的Min-K%++和跨模型top-K重叠信号在小型医学群体中因校准混淆而不可靠，但图像近邻和交换性探测器仍有效。

papers.title: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
papers.authors: Ray Zhang, Marcus Greiff, Thomas Lew, John Subosits
papers.affiliations: Toyota Research Institute
papers.intro: 提出G-CVO，通过各向异性核嵌入局部表面几何信息，并结合二阶黎曼高斯牛顿优化，在无对应配准任务中实现比一阶方法快至10倍的收敛速度和更低的漂移。

papers.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
papers.authors: Weijie Wang, Haoyu Zhao, Yifan Yang, Feng Chen, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Zicheng Duan, Donny Y. Chen, Yuqing Yang, Bohan Zhuang
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学，微软研究院，阿德莱德大学，莫纳什大学
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于潜在空间的空间记忆（latent spatial memory）机制Mirage，将场景信息直接存储在扩散模型的潜在空间中，避免了像素空间的重建与编码，实现了更高效、信息无损的3D一致视频生成，并在世界生成基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
papers.authors: Wanli Li, Bowen Zhou, Yunyao Yu, Zhou Xu, Yifan Yang, Dongsheng Li, Caihua Shan
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学、微软亚洲研究院、清华大学
papers.intro: WeaveBench是一个长跨度、真实世界、混合接口的计算机使用代理基准测试，包含114个跨8个领域的任务，每个任务都要求代理在单一轨迹内协调GUI和CLI/代码操作，并通过轨迹感知评估器来防止作弊，实验表明最先进模型和运行时的最佳通过率仅为41.2%，远未饱和。

papers.title: Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Minghang Zheng, Zihao Yin, Yi Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, video generation, diffusion model, video search
papers.affiliations: Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University; Central Media Technology Institute, Huawei Technologies Ltd.; State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出TaRO（Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization）框架，通过构建性推理探索和时序敏感性奖励，显式增强MLLMs在视频时间定位中"随时间思考"的能力，实现最先进的性能。

papers.title: IMAGINE: Adaptive Schema-Imagery Enhanced Composition for Composed Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Jiale Huang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Chunxiao Wang, Yupeng Hu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, vision transformer, video search
papers.affiliations: Shandong University; Qilu University of Technology (Shandong Academy of Sciences)
papers.intro: IMAGINE通过动态多模态原型显式物化“imagery space”（隐含语义空间），利用置信度调制的跨空间融合机制，在CVR和CIR任务中弥合显式视觉内容与隐式检索意图之间的鸿沟，并取得了SOTA性能。

papers.title: Decoupling Semantics and Logic: A Training-Free Coarse-to-Fine Pipeline for Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Jiaxin Dai, Zehang Wei, Jiamin Yan, Xiang Xiang
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology（华中科技大学），中国
papers.intro: 本文提出C2F-RAG，一个完全无需训练的两阶段级联视频RAG流水线，通过将语义检索（BGE-M3密集向量预取）与逻辑推理（基于LLM的适应型A.I.R.认知重排）显式解耦，实现了高精度检索、严格人设遵循和带chunk级时间引用的无幻觉生成。

papers.title: Watch, Remember, Reason: Human-View Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.authors: Jiahao Meng, Yue Tan, Qi Xu, Kuan Gao, Weisong Liu, Yanwei Li, Jason Li, Lingdong Kong, Haochen Wang, Qianyu Zhou, Jiangning Zhang, Guangliang Cheng, Yunhai Tong, Lu Qi, Minghsuan Yang
papers.affiliations: Peking University; Wuhan University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Nanyang Technological University; CASIA; University of Tokyo; University of Liverpool; Zhejiang University; National University of Singapore; UC Merced
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于人类认知的“观看—记忆—推理”（Watch–Remember–Reason）统一视角，综述了MLLM视频理解领域的代表性方法、数据集、基准与未来方向。

papers.title: PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Shaohui Dai, Yansong Qu, You Shen, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao
papers.tags: scene understanding, instance segmentation, multimodal learning, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing, Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University
papers.intro: 本文提出了PAR3D，一个统一的零件感知3D-MLLM框架，通过引入带零件标注的合成数据集ScenePart、零件感知的3D表示学习和层级分割查询生成，使模型能够在3D场景中同时理解和定位物体及其精细零件。

papers.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
papers.authors: Chenming Zhu, Jingli Lin, Yilin Long, Peizhou Cao, Tai Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Xihui Liu
papers.tags: image generation, scene understanding, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: 混合机构（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出Astra框架，通过将VLM与一个动作条件型世界模拟器耦合，并利用强化学习训练VLM策略学会何时、何地、如何主动调用模拟器生成想象视图，从而提升视觉空间推理能力。

papers.title: A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology
papers.authors: Tengfei Zhang, Ziheng Zhao, Lisong Dai, Xiaoman Zhang, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, image retrieval, visual question answering
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (Tengfei Zhang); School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Ziheng Zhao, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Tengfei Zhang, Ziheng Zhao, Pengcheng Qiu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie); Department of Radiology, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University (Lisong Dai); Shanghai Sixth People’s Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Lisong Dai); Department of Biomedical Informatics, Harvard Medical School (Xiaoman Zhang)
papers.intro: 该论文提出了一个实体感知的视觉-语言框架（MedReCo与MedReCo-VLM），通过构建大规模多模态数据集（MedReCo-DB），实现了可控制的参考病例检索和生成式时间对比解释，在内部、外部和跨中心评估中均显著优于基线方法。

papers.title: HomeWorld: A Unified Floorplan-to-Furnished Framework for Generating Controllable, Densely Interactive Whole-Home Scenes
papers.authors: Wenbo Li, Xiaoliang Ju, Zipeng Qin, Rongyao Fang, Hongsheng Li
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, scene understanding, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Ace Robotics, CUHK MMLab, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出一个统一的分层框架HomeWorld，通过结合大规模真实平面图数据集、LLM平面图生成、图像驱动的分层家具布局和VLM递归细化器，实现了从文本提示到可控、密集交互的完整家庭场景的自动化生成。

papers.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Qiwei Zeng, Hao Wang, Jinghao Lin, Shuchang Ye, Yuezhe Yang, Yige Peng, Haoyuan Che, Jinman Kim, Lei Bi
papers.affiliations: Jilin University, The University of Sydney, ByteDance, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出EasyLens，一个无需训练、即插即用的微小病变表征放大器，通过在冻结的医学视觉语言模型的视觉嵌入空间中，利用原型推理和形态引导的残差增强，选择并强化病变相关补丁的表征，从而提升模型对微小病变的检测和报告生成能力。

papers.title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Qi Xu, Yue Tan, Shihao Chen, Jiahao Meng, Anna Wang, Shunping Ji, Hao Fei, Jason Li
papers.affiliations: 武汉大学、北京大学、南洋理工大学、牛津大学（依据脚注：1Wuhan University, 2Peking University, 3Nanyang Technological University, 4University of Oxford）
papers.intro: 该论文首次系统性地定义并研究了“一对多时序定位（OMTG）”任务，通过构建包含56k样本的高质量数据集、设计自动化四阶段数据构建pipeline、提出新的评估指标（C-Acc和EtF1）以及基于时序奖励和字幕奖励的GRPO强化学习框架，使模型在OMTG Bench上取得43.65%的EtF1分数，大…

papers.title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning
papers.authors: Ziyang Yu, Xiang Li, Qiong Chang, Jun Miyazaki
papers.affiliations: Institute of Science Tokyo (东京科学大学)
papers.intro: 本文提出RadiusFPS，一种基于球形体素剪枝的FPS加速框架，通过保守的几何边界剪枝和坐标级点跳过测试，在保持标准FPS更新规则和输出结果的前提下，在CPU和GPU上实现了显著的加速效果，并大幅降低了内存占用。

papers.title: GRAMformer: Any-Order Modality Interactions via Volumetric Multimodal Cross-Attention
papers.authors: Giordano Cicchetti, Eleonora Grassucci, Danilo Comminiello
papers.affiliations: Dept. of Information Engineering, Electronics, and Telecommunications, Sapienza University of Rome, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出体积多模态交叉注意力（VMA），通过计算查询与多个键向量张成的平行多面体体积作为注意力分数，结合点积正则项，实现原生任意阶模态交互，并集成到轻量级Transformer架构GRAMformer中，在情感分析任务上取得更优性能。
